note: First-floor counter room, repainted 2026-10-22 (fix2): sage-green walls, oak herringbone parquet, crystal chandelier; stairwell going DOWN at the far left, staircase going UP on the back wall, the banker's desk by the river window at the right is the zoom. Feminine LEFT: brass shopping-bag gauge on the wall (consommation), banker buffing his gold star (réputation), two clerks on strike beside blank placards (grève), old tailor whose giant pin pins a red rosette to his apron (épingle). Masculine RIGHT: Sue dropping a coin into the money box (sou), boy paying with a crayon-scribbled card and giant crayon (crédit), silhouette artist holding up a cut-out profile (profil), man in a mustard suit opening a wallet of foil-wrapped notes (portefeuille). 8 words; accès, gage and the river words sit in the desk zoom of this same room.
